## Statements

- Stated by vendor (xai-reasoning, The reasoning_effort parameter): Leave out stop sequences and presence or frequency penalties; Grok reasoning models return an error when a request sets them.
- Stated by harness (xai-build-rules, Discovery): Grok Build reads CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md from the repository root down to the working directory, whole and uncapped. Keep those files short; it follows short rules more reliably.
- Stated by vendor (xai-grok-4-7, Important details): Set a prompt_cache_key (x-grok-conv-id on Chat Completions) so a conversation's requests reach one server; without it cache hits are unreliable and input is often billed at full price.
